propositions: Extend autodeploy.sh with an mcp target that implements blue-green deployment via immutable image tagging and atomic nginx upstream pointer swap, tracking origin/main without killing in-flight certified operations.
Memory pre-check gate aborts deployment if MemAvailable is below MCP_MEM_MIN_MB threshold, emitting AUTODEPLOY_MCP_MEM_ABORT backoff without starting a new container.

New mcp container starts on a free A/B port (8092 or 8093) via docker run, passes /health check within MCP_HEALTH_TIMEOUT, and triggers atomic nginx include rewrite and reload; failure leaves old container unchanged and emits AUTODEPLOY_ERROR backoff.

Old mcp container is retired gracefully via docker stop --time 1260 (SIGTERM self-drain) issued in background without waiting, never SIGKILL; exited containers are reaped each tick respecting MCP_RELEASES_CAP port pool constraint.
Port exhaustion when both A/B ports are bound by in-flight containers prevents new deployment, emits AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP backoff, and does not start a third container.
Compose parity oracle asserts mcp_run_new docker run environment variables, ro mounts, and container configuration exactly replicate the mcp: service definition to guard against auth/config drift.
